source_quote.description: optional (1.9): word-for-word sentence from chunk_id that proves the answer

second_model.description: optional (1.11): the second model's reply, for the record. A pass proves little on its own: same_subject and about_topic were true on every replayed draft.

origin.description: optional (1.12): general_practice = a fixed question written by hand, not made from this course's notes and not from the AI check. Absent on questions from the quiz generator.

generation.description: optional (1.6): how the items were generated: model, prompt_version, temperature, seed, skipped items per reason, concepts without chunks or items

skipped.description: dropped drafts per reason, over every attempt (retries included since 1.10)

check_model.description: optional (1.9): the second model that checks each draft; null when the check was off or the prompt is not quiz_v2

check_prompt_version.description: optional (1.9): the check prompt, quiz_check_v2 since 1.10; null when the check did not run

items_checked.description: optional (1.9): drafts sent to the check model

min_items_per_topic.description: optional (1.10): below this a topic gets one retry; null when the prompt is not quiz_v2

retry_prompt_version.description: optional (1.10): the retry prompt; null when the prompt is not quiz_v2

topics_retried.description: optional (1.10): concept ids that got the one retry

skipped_on_retry.description: optional (1.10): the part of skipped that came from retries, per reason

check_version.description: optional (1.11): the checks as a whole, such as quiz_check_v3

dropped.description: optional (1.11): every dropped draft with its reason
